summary: A route stops making its client and starts asking for it. You add deps.py with get_llm_client, change two routes to use Depends, see an old monkeypatch test fail, and swap the client in tests with dependency_overrides.
goal: Change which LLM client every route uses in one place, and swap it in a test.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: add deps.py, change the two routes, see the monkeypatch test fail, then fix it and see 5 passed
Step 2: make get_llm_client return a fixed reply, predict both routes, then check
Step 3: remove Depends and read the FastAPIError, then leak an override and see other tests fail
Step 4: write LoudFakeClient and a test that swaps it in with dependency_overrides
Play the Swap Master game to the end and see your score
